result:
The decisive mistake was made by Verification_Expert at step 6. It claimed to have verified the links and endorsed the search-result pages (including CanFam4 and later papers) as the May 2020 files. It never checked them, and it missed that CanFam3.1 from the Broad Institute FTP was the relevant assembly. The Bioinformatics_Expert's search query was also weak, but the verifier should have caught that the results were wrong.
